_engine: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini) — SEMPRE usar --pro para simbolos
_instructions: Substitua todos os valores {placeholder}. Gere via: node scripts/generate-image.js --prompt '...' --pro
_estetica: ESTETICA ACIMA DE TUDO. Simbolo unico, nunca visto, bonito. PROIBIDO: formas genericas (triangulo+circulo, seta, engrenagem, lampada, escudo).

assets.description: Simbolo principal da marca — preto no branco — UNICO e INEDITO

prompt_template.layer_1_tecnica: Award-winning logo symbol. Pure white background. Single solid black color. No gradients, no shadows, no outlines, no fill patterns. Vector-clean edges, mathematically precise curves. Must work perfectly at 16x16px favicon AND 500x500px print. No text, no letters, no numbers. Pure abstract symbol only.
prompt_template.layer_2_conceito: The symbol represents the invisible moment where {CONCEITO_1} transforms into {CONCEITO_2}, captured through the visual language of {CONCEITO_3}. NOT a literal representation. NOT an obvious geometric shape. The symbol should feel like it was discovered, not designed. Think: the elegance of the Apple logo, the tension of the Nike swoosh, the hidden meaning of the FedEx arrow, the duality of the Beats logo.
prompt_template.layer_3_anticliche: CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: Do NOT create a circle with something inside it. Do NOT create a triangle, diamond, or hexagon as the base shape. Do NOT use arrows, checkmarks, lightbulbs, gears, shields, or crowns. Do NOT stack basic geometric shapes on top of each other. The silhouette must be UNIQUE — not recognizable as any existing logo. Use negative space as a design element, not just background. Asymmetry is welcome if it creates visual tension. The symbol must have a discovery moment — a hidden detail that rewards closer inspection.

quality_checklist: O simbolo e UNICO? Nao lembra nenhum logo existente?
Funciona em 16x16px? A silhueta e reconhecivel?
Tem um momento de descoberta visual?
NAO e uma forma geometrica basica?
E esteticamente BONITO, nao apenas funcional?
